purpose: Versioned selective source index with a growing cross-disciplinary syllabus. A 10x / 100x literature ambition is an explicit target, never counted as works already read.

statuses.catalogued: Reference registered for reading; no claim of having read its paper, book, recording or full text.
statuses.abstract-reviewed: Publisher/primary abstract, overview or archival summary inspected and summarized, but full text NOT read. Does not count as a completed study.
statuses.partially-studied: Requires dated reading notes citing specific sections and a named research session.
statuses.fully-studied: Requires versioned notes on the whole work, methods, limitations, citations and a session log.

methods.influenceRule: A work influences the measured single-history vs many-histories direction only if it demonstrates a verifiable prediction that differentiates candidates after alternatives and dependencies are considered. Bibliographic influence alone has no compass impact.
methods.countingRule: Only 'fully-studied' records count as completed full works; abstracts and catalogue entries are separate. Avoid duplicated counts for same DOI or coauthored work; count per work once and per field once.
methods.notesRule: Advance a work only with source ID, exact section/pages, study date, researcher/session, claim, methods, limitations, alternative interpretations and evidence-led impact reason.
methods.datePrecision: A catalogue entry's year is publication year, not the date personally studied.

verdictAudit.empiricalConclusion: Unresolved: no confirmed empirical discrimination between a single experienced physical history and branching Everettian histories, nor demonstration of traversable backward time travel.
verdictAudit.initialScoreExplanation: 59 is a preexisting editorial illustration, not a scientifically validated Bayesian posterior. No newly indexed work warrants an adjustment.

changeLog.justification: The cited works are important to relativity, measurement or hypothetical loop consistency but do not supply direct discriminating physical evidence for timeline multiplicity. Indexing alone cannot shift an editorial meter.

changeLog.trigger: Twelve additional verified bibliographic records and four new abstract-level critical notes
changeLog.justification: The wormhole model is conditional, the collapse model is a proposed alternative, the Wigner-friend inequality result requires specific assumptions, and large-molecule interference tests coherence; none presently distinguishes a physical plurality of histories from a single realized history. New bibliography and abstract-level review therefore increase scientific coverage but not the editorial verdict.

changeLog.trigger: Targeted primary-paper section-level reading of Gödel, Hawking and Deutsch; abstract-level counterchecks of Politzer and Lloyd et al.
changeLog.justification: Gödel supplies an exact CTC spacetime, not an observation. Hawking's formation obstruction has specific energy/horizon assumptions and semiclassical caveats; Deutsch proves a fixed-point result given a CTC rather than establishing one. Politzer and Lloyd expose model dependence. None directly measures or distinguishes the count of physically realized histories; 59 is editorial and not an empirical probability.

changeLog.trigger: Independent limited algebra checks of Gödel's circular-orbit sign and Deutsch-style one-bit channel fixed points
changeLog.justification: Replicating the radius threshold and self-consistent 2x2 density-matrix toy verifies conditional mathematics of stipulated models but supplies no physical detection of real CTCs or multiple quantum histories. No measurable discrimination; no score adjustment.
